ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given: As shown in the figure, $OC$ is the bisector of $\angle AOB$. When $\angle AOB = 60^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle AOC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that OC bisects $\angle AOB$,\\
it follows that $\angle AOC= \frac{1}{2}\angle AOB$,\\
since $\angle AOB=60^\circ$,\\
we find $\angle AOC=\boxed{30^\circ}$.
